title: Installed Playwright CLI rejects the --config invocation documented by its bundled README while PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_CONFIG works
workflow: materialize owner-native binding config -> invoke upstream CLI -> open Chromium consumer
observed_during: real browser consumption of media:archive-archipelago-001 interactive polish
symptom: Two attempts using --config with the materialized owner-native config failed immediately with `Unknown option: --config`.
expected_behavior: The materialized binding should have one obvious directly usable invocation route for the exact installed CLI version.
actual_behavior: The installed package README mentions --config, but this executable rejects it; exporting PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_CONFIG to the same materialized config succeeds and launches the exact Workstation-bound Chromium.
proposed_fix: Have the owner-native binding expose or document the verified PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_CONFIG route for this installed version, or otherwise reconcile the version/config CLI contract. Do not install another browser.
fix_attempt: Media consumer used the supported PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_CONFIG environment route without modifying Workstation owner code.
verification: Chromium interaction suite passed through the exact materialized config and exact Workstation-bound Chromium executable.
